aesthetic_summary: Cyberpunk research-lab with a dark base, neon accents (Electric Blue, Amber, Neon Pink), animated grid backgrounds, glassmorphism panels, and a terminal/mono-serif typography mix. The layout is left-aligned and asymmetric, mimicking an underground data control room.

fonts.heading: Unbounded
fonts.install_instructions: Import 'Unbounded' and 'JetBrains Mono' from Google Fonts into the index.css or via next/font if using Next.js. Avoid Inter and Space Grotesk completely.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase

spacing_and_layout.details: Dense, highly structured, yet asymmetrical. Containers should use ample internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision. Left-align content for readability. Avoid central symmetry.
spacing_and_layout.canvas_area: The central node editor takes up the majority of the screen width (col-span-8 or col-span-9 in a 12-col grid), while side panels slide in from the right.
spacing_and_layout.borders_and_radii: Sharp edges preferred, max 4px radius (rounded-sm) for subtle smoothing. The 'Tracing Beam' surface strategy applies to active nodes.

visual_enhancers.background_grid: Animated SVG dot grid or line grid overlay. Opacity 5%. Dots colored #00E5FF. Subtle pulsating animation via CSS.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle noise/grain overlay (pointer-events-none, fixed, mix-blend-overlay, opacity-20) to break digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use pure 'Optical Clarity' glass: bg-black/40 with backdrop-blur-2xl, border-t border-l border-white/10, and an inner box-shadow for depth.
visual_enhancers.scanlines: Linear repeating gradient (transparent 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 50%) applied to panels for a CRT/terminal feel.

HeroSearchBar.description: A massive, terminal-like command line input dominating the top section.
HeroSearchBar.styles: bg-[#0D0D12] border-b-2 border-[#00E5FF] text-2xl font-body text-[#00E5FF] px-8 py-6 focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 focus:shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(0,229,255,0.2)] transition-all placeholder:text-[#00E5FF]/30

PaperCard.styles: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 p-6 rounded-sm hover:border-[#00E5FF]/40 hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all group relative overflow-hidden
PaperCard.inner_elements: Include an overline for 'ArXiv', heading for paper title, muted text for abstract snippet. The left border should highlight on hover with #00E5FF.

WisdomCard.styles: bg-gradient-to-br from-[#16161E] to-[#0D0D12] border border-[#FFB000]/30 p-6 rounded-sm relative
WisdomCard.inner_elements: Use an Amber glowing icon (lucide-react). Include a 'Tracing Beam' border effect if possible. Text should feel highly legible, with key flaws highlighted in #FF0055.

AwesomeListCard.description: Curated GitHub repos for the topic.
AwesomeListCard.styles: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 p-4 rounded-sm flex items-center gap-4 hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors

NodeEditorCanvas.description: Central interactive area. Use a library like React Flow if available, highly customized to match the cyberpunk aesthetic.
NodeEditorCanvas.background: Dark space (#060608) with a 20px-spaced dot grid. Dots pulsate slightly.
NodeEditorCanvas.edges: Animated dashed lines or solid glowing lines (#00E5FF) with 'flowing' particles moving from source to target.

Node.description: A single architecture node within the canvas.
Node.styles: bg-[#0D0D12]/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 p-4 min-w-[200px] shadow-lg flex flex-col gap-2 transition-transform cursor-pointer

AlgorithmDrawer.description: Right-side sliding panel (Framer Motion) revealing related algorithms when a node is clicked.
AlgorithmDrawer.styles: fixed right-0 top-0 h-full w-[400px] max-w-full bg-[#060608]/95 backdrop-blur-3xl border-l border-white/10 p-8 shadow-2xl z-50 overflow-y-auto scanline-bg

AlgorithmSwapItem.description: List item in the drawer showing alternative algorithms (e.g., swapping ResNet for ViT).
AlgorithmSwapItem.styles: p-4 border border-white/10 hover:border-[#FFB000] bg-white/5 cursor-pointer flex justify-between items-center group transition-colors
AlgorithmSwapItem.badges: Include tiny monospace badges for 'Popularity', 'VRAM', 'Latency'. Badges should have harsh 1px borders and bright text.

SkillExportPreview.description: Live preview of the generated SKILL.md file.
SkillExportPreview.styles: bg-[#0D0D12] text-[#F3F4F6] font-body p-8 border border-white/10 overflow-auto text-sm
SkillExportPreview.markdown_styles: YAML front-matter tinted in #FFB000, headings in #00E5FF. Strict monospaced typography here.

AuthHeader.description: Top navigation including Google Login and Dashboard links.
AuthHeader.styles: w-full h-16 border-b border-white/10 bg-[#060608]/80 backdrop-blur-md px-8 flex justify-between items-center z-50 sticky top-0
AuthHeader.button_style: bg-white/10 text-white px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold tracking-wider hover:bg-white/20 transition-colors uppercase border border-white/20

micro_animations.hover: All interactive elements should subtly translate upwards (-translate-y-0.5) and have their border transition to a neon color.
micro_animations.click: Scale down slightly (scale-95) for a tactile feel.
micro_animations.data_flow: Use SVG stroke-dashoffset animations for the connection lines in the node graph to simulate data moving.

icons.instructions: Use with stroke-width 1.5. Tint icons to match the neon accent colors contextually.

hero_backgrounds.description: Abstract grid pattern with warm and cool lighting. Use as a very low opacity (5-10%) background texture for the entire app body or the hero landing.
Abstract grid pattern with red and blue light. Great for the 'Algorithm Drawer' background texture overlay.

avatars.description: Cyberpunk researcher illuminated by x-ray/data. Use for the logged-in user profile avatar in the AuthHeader.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: 'npm install framer-motion lucide-react reactflow @radix-ui/react-icons'.
Configure Tailwind for the new fonts: Unbounded (sans) and JetBrains Mono (mono).
Ensure all components are strictly written in .js/.jsx, NOT TypeScript.
Do not use generic UI cards. Adhere strictly to the 'Tracing Beam', 'Scanline', and 'Glassmorphism' surface strategies defined in these guidelines.
Ensure the Node Graph editor uses 'reactflow' with custom node components built visually matching the 'Node' specifications.
Every interactive element MUST have the specified 'data-testid' attribute.
NEVER use placeholder image URLs. Use the provided Unsplash URLs in the media section.
The SKILL.md preview should be formatted to look like a raw markdown file in an IDE.
